items.text: Please note that the deadline for submitting your 2024 self-assessment tax return is 31 January 2025. Late submissions may incur penalties.

As part of our ongoing commitment to security, we are updating our password policy effective 1 March 2025. All employees will be required to use passphrases of at least 16 characters, including a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols. Passwords must be changed every 90 days, and reuse of the last five passwords is prohibited.

To help you manage this, we recommend using a reputable password manager. The IT department will host drop-in sessions on 20 and 22 February to assist with setup. Remember, never share your password with anyone, including IT staff. If you have any questions, please contact the IT helpdesk.

We understand that this may seem like an inconvenience, but these measures are essential to protect our data. Your cooperation is appreciated.

The conference schedule for the 2025 Global AI Summit is now available on our website. Keynote sessions will be held in the main auditorium, while workshops will take place in breakout rooms. Please note that some sessions may be recorded for later viewing. Disregard any previous schedules you may have received, as they are now outdated.

When interacting with our new AI assistant, please be aware that it is designed to provide general information only. It should not be used for urgent matters. For urgent issues, contact a human representative immediately. The assistant can help with password resets and conference room bookings.

Please remember that your password should never be written down or stored in an unsecured file. If you suspect your password has been compromised, change it immediately and notify the security team. The IT department has provided a guide on creating strong passwords. Urgent action is required if you receive a password expiration notice.
Tax season is here! Ensure you have all necessary documents before filing. Visit our website for a checklist.

The annual developer conference is scheduled for 15-17 May 2025. The detailed agenda is now available online. Sessions will cover topics such as machine learning, web development, and cloud computing. Please review the schedule and plan your attendance accordingly.

Registration is open until 30 April. Early bird pricing ends on 15 March. We encourage you to register early to secure your spot. The conference will feature keynote speeches from industry leaders, hands-on workshops, and networking opportunities.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to the organizing committee at events@devconf.com. We look forward to seeing you there!

Our password policy requires all users to enable two-factor authentication. This adds an extra layer of security. If you have not yet enabled it, please do so by the end of the month. For assistance, contact support.

The tax filing deadline for the 2024 tax year is 15 April 2025. Late filing may result in penalties and interest. If you need an extension, submit Form 4868 by the deadline. Our office is available to assist with your tax preparation needs.

We have updated our conference schedule to include additional breakout sessions. Please check the website for the latest version. The schedule is subject to change, so please review it before the event. Disregard any printed schedules from previous years.
